t: An Omani Arab sultanate on Zanzibar and Pemba, separated from Oman when Sayyid Said’s realm was divided in 1856.
Clove plantations, ivory caravans and the slave market made Zanzibar the commercial capital of East Africa.
European partition stripped its mainland claims; it became a British protectorate in 1890 and fell in the revolution of 1964.
dyk: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 27 August 1896 is often called the shortest war in recorded history: the British bombardment of the sultan’s palace lasted less than an hour.
ev: Majid bin Said becomes sultan of Zanzibar on the division of Sayyid Said’s realm
The Canning Award confirms Zanzibar’s separation from Oman
Barghash closes the Zanzibar slave market under British pressure
A German squadron forces Barghash to recognise German claims on the mainland
Zanzibar and Pemba become a British protectorate
The Anglo-Zanzibar War ends in under an hour
Zanzibar becomes independent under Sultan Jamshid bin Abdullah
The Zanzibar Revolution overthrows the sultan; union with Tanganyika follows
